caseNameFull: Virginia Huey v. D. A. Brock
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Alabama.
attorneys: Mr. George H. Lamar, with whom Mr. Theodore J. Lamar was on the brief, for plaintiffs in error., No appearance for defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by .the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726; Jett Bros. Distilling Co. v. Carrollton, 252 U. S. 1, 5-6.
